mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xw_tool_event (task_id, tool_call_id, tool_name, mcp_server, tool_args, tool_output, status, duration_ms) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{toolCallId}, #{toolName}, #{mcpServer}, #{toolArgs}, #{toolOutput}, #{status}, #{durationMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE tool_name = #{toolName}, mcp_server = IFNULL(#{mcpServer}, mcp_server), tool_args = IFNULL(#{toolArgs}, tool_args), tool_output = IFNULL(#{toolOutput}, tool_output), status = #{status}, duration_ms = IFNULL(#{durationMs}, duration_ms), updated_at = NOW()
